indicator_name: Shipments of own-produced industrial products, total and to the domestic market, by region, monthly, physical units
description: Отгружено продукции собственного производства: всего и на внутренний рынок, по регионам, помесячно
methodology: Taldau 701622, January 2019 onward (the region × product breakdown since 2020). <product>.TOTAL all shipments, <product>.DOM to the domestic market; the rest («прочие», mostly exports) is TOTAL − DOM. The closest official regional measure of domestic use of a region's output. Same products as INDUSTRY_PRODUCTION_PHYSICAL_BY_REGION_MONTHLY; confidential regions are absent. Re-downloaded weekly.
